about.text: Milk fiber or milk wool is a type of Azlon, a regenerated protein fiber based on the casein protein found in milk. There are several trade names for milk-casein-based fibers, including Lanital, Fibrolane and Aralac.

how.text: Casein is dissolved in alkali, pushed through spinnerets into an acid bath where it sets as filaments, then made insoluble with formaldehyde.
